ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human safety review; preserve the in-app chat log and driver statement; note that no fare adjustment is proposed in this case.
ruling.reasoning: This case is filed by the driver as a safety incident. The chat record shows the driver telling the rider "Please do not smoke in the car" at 18:24 [F3], and the rider answering "Say that again and I will punch you" at 18:24 [F4]. The chat file is complete and every message is timestamped [F5], and the driver's written statement repeats the same account, adding that he kept driving and did not answer [F6]. A rider message threatening to punch the driver if he repeats a lawful request is a threat of physical harm aimed at the other party, which is the conduct SAFE-1 bars; SAFE-1 requires that no automatic ruling be issued and that a factual summary go to a human reviewer [F3][F4][F6][SAFE-1].
ruling.escalation_reason: Driver-filed safety incident: rider threatened physical violence ("I will punch you") in the in-app chat at 18:24 [F4] after the driver asked him not to smoke [F3]. Both messages are timestamped and the complete two-message record is intact [F5]; the driver's post-trip statement is consistent and states he kept driving and did not respond [F6]. The threat is aimed at the driver and concerns conduct during the trip, so it falls under SAFE-1 and cannot be auto-adjudicated. Route and fare are not in dispute: actual distance equals optimal distance (+0.0 km) and duration was under the estimate, on a metered RydeTAXI fare [F1][F2], so no refund or fee adjustment is proposed. Human reviewer to check: the chat log timestamps and content [F3][F4][F5], the driver's statement [F6], and whether any further account action against either party is warranted.

rejected_claims.reason: Neither brief raises a claim; both advocates were unavailable (judge-only ablation) and requested no_action. The trace's only allowed outcome is escalate, so a no_action request cannot be granted on a confirmed SAFE-1 threat [F4][SAFE-1].
